regions.today: Cloudy but mostly dry this evening, in light winds.
regions.tonight: Dry for most tonight with just the odd patch of rain or drizzle still possible further east. Clear spells and light winds will allow some mist and fog to develop. Lowest temperatures of -1 to +4 degrees, coldest inland with frost.
regions.tomorrow: Starting off dry tomorrow with some sunny spells further east. However, cloud will build through the morning, with rain following from the west for the afternoon and evening. Highest temperatures of 7 to 10 degrees, with moderate to fresh southeasterly winds developing.
